yt_title: How to find a recipe you saved on Instagram
caption:
You saved a recipe. Find it. I'll wait.

Instagram first: check Saved, and your Collections if you made them.

No collections? SaveSort sorts every save by topic and pulls out the 30 worth doing, so you're scrolling 30, not 156. There's no recipe topic yet.

How to sort your Instagram saved reels: download your Instagram data, tick only Saved, drop the zip into SaveSort. Runs in your browser, nothing gets uploaded.

Want 30 to scroll, not 156? Sort yours free, link in bio.

Sorty's voice is AI. The saves and numbers are real.
